short: Enhanced electromagnetic wave absorption property of binary
title: Enhanced electromagnetic wave absorption property of binary ZnO/NiCo2O4 composites

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Coupling dielectric ZnO with NiCo2O4 nano-dots in one binary composite should enhance EM wave absorption through added interfacial polarization. Binary ZnO/NiCo2O4 nanocomposite chosen as the absorber: semiconducting ZnO with a NiCo2O4 second phase.
states.detail: Absorbed: h1 (HYP/hypothesis), d1 (DES/base_system), d2 (DES/variable_sweep), p1 (PRC/synthesis), p2 (PRC/synthesis)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Only ZnO and NiCo2O4 phases are present in all three samples; no impurity phase. NiCo2O4 nano-dots a few nm across sit on ZnO particles, forming ZnO/NiCo2O4 heterointerfaces.

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Charges redistribute across ZnO/NiCo2O4 nano-dot interfaces under the AC field, adding interfacial relaxation to ZnO dielectric loss. Complex permittivity (both e' and e'') rises with NH3.H2O content, -5 < -7 < -10.
states.detail: Absorbed: m1 (MEC/pathway), r1 (PRP/value), r2 (PRP/value), r3 (PRP/value), r4 (PRP/value), m2 (MEC/pathway). Premises: C0 = mu''(mu')^-2 f^-1 staying constant with frequency indicates eddy-current loss; |Delta| < 0.4 marks good impedance matching; Transmission-line theory gives RL, Delta and attenuation constant from e, mu, frequency and thickness

states.title: Performance state
states.head: -7 reaches the deepest reflection loss (about -33.5 dB at 18 GHz, ~5 mm), -10 about -27.5 dB, -5 only about -6.5 dB. -7 and -10 pass RL < -10 dB only in the upper Ku band (~16.5-18 GHz) at >= ~4.7 mm; -5 never passes
states.detail: Absorbed: f1 (PRF/service_capability), f2 (PRF/qualification). Premises: RL = -10 dB corresponds to 90% absorption

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Raising NH3.H2O in binary ZnO/NiCo2O4 raises dielectric and interfacial-relaxation loss, giving Ku-band absorbers with RLmin -33.49 dB

nodes.title: evidence, F8
nodes.head: RL colour-map minima are -6.52 (a), -33.50 (c) and -27.50 (e) dB; deep RL in c and e lies only at the top-right corner (>= ~4.5 mm, >= ~17 GHz). RL minima for -7 and -10 sit at the 18 GHz edge of the measured band with curves still falling
nodes.solves: -7 reaches the deepest reflection loss (about -33.5 dB at 18 GHz, ~5 mm), -10 about -27.5 dB, -5 only about -6.5 dB
nodes.op: read characteristic point, replot derived series
nodes.note: Map a has its deepest spot (-6.52) near 13 GHz and ~2.5 mm; the -5 curves in F8b also reach ~-6.3 dB at 18 GHz for 5.00 mm, so the text value (-6.52 dB at 18 GHz, 5.0 mm) is consistent with F8b to within reading error and the map minimum is a second, equal-depth spot near where e' of -5 spikes (F5a). Linked text cites Fig. 8(b)/(d)/(f) for -7/-10/-5, but by caption, colour-bar range and the F8b/d/f curve minima (-6.5/-33/-27 dB), -5 is (a,b), -7 is (c,d), -10 is (e,f). In maps c and e the deep colours are confined to the top-right corner pixel region. the reported RLmin is a band-edge value, not a located absorption peak: in F8d and F8f the 4.99/5.00 mm curves are still falling steeply at 18 GHz; the true minimum may lie above 18 GHz
